answer: Agents bond stake before evaluating the epoch polynomial, whose committed coefficients bind each Semaphore identity to rate-limit proofs and nullifiers. A valid message reveals only a scope-bound share; exceeding the limit with distinct messages in the same epoch exposes enough Shamir shares to reconstruct the private key, enabling immediate collateral slashing. The ridge, meadow, and ripple can describe network regions and traffic, but do not alter this cryptographic enforcement rule.
